headline: UDR (NYSE:UDR): Dividend Stock Beats Earnings Estimates and Raises Guidance, Yet Shares Fall
summary: UDR (NYSE:UDR) beat Q2 FFO estimates and raised full-year guidance, but revenue slightly missed. Shares slumped 12.7% after hours despite strong operating trends.
